## apiome repository {#repository}

Repository auto-refresh: trigger a refresh and inspect per-file state.

```text
apiome repository [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`refresh`](#repository-refresh).

## apiome repository refresh {#repository-refresh}

Trigger a spec-faithful repository refresh (``refresh REPO``) or list per-file refresh state (``refresh status REPO``).

```text
apiome repository refresh [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`status`](#repository-refresh-status).

## apiome repository refresh status {#repository-refresh-status}

List per-file refresh state for a repository (RAR-1.5 / RAR-2.3).

```text
apiome repository refresh status [OPTIONS] REPO
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `REPOSITORY` | text | yes | Repository UUID or name (for example ``acme/api``, matched against the repository's full name and then its display name). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--path` | text |  |  | Restrict the listing to one repository-relative file path. |
| `--branch` | text |  |  | Restrict the listing to one branch (implies --all-branches). |
| `--all-branches` | flag |  |  | List lineages on every tracked branch, not just the default branch. |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` |  | Maximum file lineages to read (1..500). |
| `--format` | text |  |  | Output format: table (default) or json. |
